content:
{'text': '在Nathan Fielder執導、講述Elizabeth Holmes的紀錄片《You Can See Everything》上映後，Theranos吹哨人Tyler Shultz表示，稱該公司創辦人沒有做錯任何事的說法「完全不實」。', 'paragraph_context': 'After the release of "You Can See Everything," the Nathan Fielder-directed documentary about Elizabeth Holmes, Theranos whistleblower Tyler Shultz said it was "completely untrue" that the company\'s founder did nothing wrong.'}

{'text': '「她知道自己一直在撒謊，因為如果你真的相信那些謊言，根本不需要編織出這整套謊言網。」Shultz在星期一播出的《CBS Mornings》節目中說道。', 'paragraph_context': '"She knows that she was lying because she created this whole web of lies that you would not have needed to create if you actually believed the lies," Shultz said on Monday\'s episode of "CBS Mornings."'}

{'text': '在《You Can See Everything》中，Fielder和他的團隊在Holmes入獄服刑前夕，與她及其丈夫共度了30天。她因電匯詐騙及欺詐其科技公司Theranos的投資者而入獄。', 'paragraph_context': 'In "You Can See Everything," Fielder and his crew spend 30 days with Holmes and her husband right before she heads to prison for wire fraud and defrauding investors in her tech company, Theranos.'}

{'text': 'Shultz曾在Theranos工作，也是John Carreyrou 2015年在《華爾街日報》撰文揭發該公司名不副實的主要消息來源之一。他還表示，對Holmes在紀錄片中的樣子感到「非常震驚」。他說，他認識的Holmes「完全能夠掌控全場」，而紀錄片中的那位女士「看起來像個心靈破碎的女人」。', 'paragraph_context': 'Shultz, who worked at Theranos and was one of the main sources in John Carreyrou\'s 2015 Wall Street Journal article exposing the company for not being what it seemed, also said he was "pretty shocked" at how Holmes looked in the documentary. The Holmes he knew "completely commanded a room," he said, while the woman in the documentary "looked like a broken woman."'}

{'text': '在影片中，Holmes向Fielder展示了她聲稱能夠僅靠一滴血就進行數百項檢測的機器。Shultz表示，Holmes展示的那台機器並非他當年參與研發的裝置。', 'paragraph_context': 'In the movie, Holmes shows Fielder the machine that she claimed could run hundreds of tests with just a drop of blood. Shultz said the machine Holmes showed was not the device that he worked on.'}

{'text': '「那不是我們對監管機構隱瞞的那台裝置，」Shultz說。「那不是品質監控不過關的那台裝置。那也不是我們明知會出錯、卻仍然用來向病人提供不準確醫療資訊的那台裝置。她完全把[Fielder]誤導入一條截然不同的歧途上。」', 'paragraph_context': '"That was not the device that we hid from regulators," Shultz said. "That was not the device that failed quality controls. That was not the device that we used to knowingly give patients incorrect medical information. And she completely misled [Fielder] down this completely different rabbit hole."'}

{'text': '「那台裝置並非她入獄的原因。她入獄的原因是，我們真正使用、真正製造出來的那台裝置要原始粗糙得多，準確度極低，亦非獨立運作平台，一次只能檢測一樣東西。」他補充道。', 'paragraph_context': '"That device is not the reason she went to prison. The reason she went to prison was that the device that we actually used, that was actually built, was far more rudimentary, wildly inaccurate, was not a standalone platform, could only test for one thing at a time," he continued.'}

{'text': '當初揭發Theranos及Holmes詐騙行為的記者Carreyrou也就這部紀錄片發表了看法。他寫道，Holmes試圖把自己塑造成「一個以另類思維方式運作的神經多樣性（neurodivergent）企業家」，但「這場表演並不比她否認犯行的說辭更具說服力」。', 'paragraph_context': 'Carreyrou, the journalist who originally exposed Theranos and Holmes\' fraud, also gave his opinions on the documentary. He wrote that Holmes was trying to cast "herself as the neurodivergent entrepreneur who operated on a different wavelength," but "the performance was no more convincing than her denials of wrongdoing."'}

{'text': 'Carreyrou寫道：「Holmes女士在Fielder先生身邊顯得魅力十足，甚至有些調情意味。」「但你不時能瞥見那個冷酷無情、曾強勢反擊我的報導、並在2015及2016年追擊我的消息來源的行政總裁本色。當Fielder先生又一再問她是否肯定自己沒有做錯時，我們聽到她厲聲回應：『我沒有。』」', 'paragraph_context': '"Ms. Holmes is charming around Mr. Fielder, even flirtatious," Carreyrou wrote. "But you catch fleeting glimpses of the stone-cold chief executive who hit back forcefully against my reporting and went after my sources in 2015 and 2016. When Mr. Fielder asks her yet again whether she\'s sure she did nothing wrong, we hear her snap: \'I did not.\'"'}

{'text': '《You Can See Everything》於上週末在全美院線上映，據A24統計，該片在855塊銀幕上收穫1500萬美元票房。', 'paragraph_context': '"You Can See Everything," which premiered in movie theaters over the weekend, made $15 million from 855 screens, according to A24.'}
